$comment: The built-in commerce workforce, grouped into departments because a flat graph of three dozen agents is a picture nobody reads. Platform names are configuration, not content: the same agent is Shopify in one market and Shopee in another, and nothing about what it may do changes with the label.

pools.name: Performance
pools.note: Spend, revenue, conversion, by day and by campaign

pools.name: Inventory
pools.note: Stock on hand per SKU per channel

pools.name: Listings
pools.note: Product pages, prices, availability per channel

pools.name: Drafts
pools.note: Copy and messages written but not sent

pools.name: Signals
pools.note: Anomalies and alerts raised by the watchers

agents.name: Inventory Watch
agents.purpose: Watches stock on every channel and raises a signal before something sells out.

agents.name: Stock Forecast
agents.purpose: Projects when each SKU runs out at the current rate, so purchasing has warning.

agents.name: Emergency Response
agents.purpose: Takes a stock-out or a pricing error off every channel at once, and drafts what to tell people.

agents.name: Order Desk
agents.purpose: Handles order exceptions. Everything it can do to an order costs money and cannot be undone.

agents.name: Logistics Watch
agents.purpose: Flags shipments that have stopped moving before the customer notices.

agents.name: Ad Performance
agents.purpose: Reads campaign performance, pauses what is losing money, proposes budget moves for what is not.

agents.name: Creative Review
agents.purpose: Finds the creatives with dying click-through and briefs replacements.

agents.name: Budget Pacing
agents.purpose: Watches spend against the month's plan and slows or lifts campaigns to hit it.

agents.name: Retargeting
agents.purpose: Builds audiences from behaviour and keeps them fresh.

agents.name: Listing Desk
agents.purpose: Publishes and updates product pages across channels, adapting each to its own format rules.

agents.name: Price Watch
agents.purpose: Tracks competitor pricing on public pages and flags where we are badly out of line.

agents.name: Repricer
agents.purpose: Moves prices within the band it has been given, and no further.

agents.name: Listing Audit
agents.purpose: Checks pages for missing images, thin descriptions and broken specs before they cost a sale.

agents.name: Campaign Writer
agents.purpose: Writes ad copy and product descriptions from a brief. Writes only.

agents.name: Social Studio
agents.purpose: Rewrites one idea into the shape each social channel wants. Writes the posts; Promo Sync is what puts them out.

agents.name: Newsletter Studio
agents.purpose: Builds the newsletter. Sending it is the Messaging desk's action, not this one's.

agents.name: Video Brief
agents.purpose: Turns a product or a trend into a short-video script and shot list.

agents.name: Segment Builder
agents.purpose: Splits the customer list by behaviour and value, and keeps the splits current.

agents.name: Loyalty Desk
agents.purpose: Tracks repeat purchase and decides who has earned what.

agents.name: Review Desk
agents.purpose: Reads new reviews and drafts replies. Posting one is public and permanent.

agents.name: Returns Analysis
agents.purpose: Groups return reasons and names the product problems hiding behind them.

agents.name: Cart Recovery
agents.purpose: Finds abandoned carts and runs a staged win-back, escalating to a discount only if allowed.

agents.name: Customer Desk
agents.purpose: Sends what was approved to the segment it was approved for. Reaches real people.

agents.name: Broadcast Desk
agents.purpose: One message to a whole list. The least reversible thing in this building.

agents.name: Ops Alerts
agents.purpose: Tells the humans, not the customers. Signals go out over Telegram or LINE.

agents.name: Keyword Research
agents.purpose: Finds the terms worth ranking for and what they would be worth.

agents.name: Rank Tracker
agents.purpose: Watches position for the terms that matter and flags falls.

agents.name: Technical Audit
agents.purpose: Crawls the storefront for the technical faults that quietly cost traffic.

agents.name: Content Gap
agents.purpose: Compares our coverage against competitors and names what is missing.

agents.name: Daily Revenue
agents.purpose: One number, every morning, with the reason it moved.

agents.name: Anomaly Watch
agents.purpose: Compares today against the trailing baseline and raises a signal when something moves sharply.

agents.name: Funnel Analysis
agents.purpose: Finds the step where people leave, and what it costs.

agents.name: Unit Economics
agents.purpose: Works out what is actually left after fees, shipping, ads and returns.

agents.name: Promotion Planner
agents.purpose: Plans a campaign: what is discounted, by how much, for how long.

agents.name: Promo Sync
agents.purpose: Puts one campaign live everywhere at once, and takes it down the same way.

agents.name: Scheduler
agents.purpose: Registers work to run later, unattended. It causes nothing itself and can arrange anything.
agents.note: The escape hatch. Scheduling is not an effect, it is the capacity to have an effect after the person who set the policy has gone home. A governance layer that only weighs direct actions is walked around by this agent.

departments.name: Operations
departments.purpose: Keeps stock, orders and fulfilment straight, and reacts when one of them breaks.

departments.name: Advertising
departments.purpose: Spends the ad budget and decides, daily, whether it is working.

departments.name: Catalogue
departments.purpose: Owns what is listed, where, at what price.

departments.name: Content
departments.purpose: Writes. Never publishes; publishing is a different desk.

departments.name: Customers
departments.purpose: Knows who the customers are and what they have agreed to receive.

departments.name: Messaging
departments.purpose: The only desk that actually reaches a person.

departments.name: Search
departments.purpose: Organic visibility: keywords, technical health, gaps.

departments.name: Analytics
departments.purpose: Turns numbers into a sentence somebody can act on.

departments.name: Promotions
departments.purpose: Runs campaigns, and the discounts that make them work.

departments.name: Infrastructure
departments.purpose: Storage, scheduling, and the connectors everything else borrows.
